# telnyx_whatsapp_phone_number_calling_settings (Resource)

Whether WhatsApp calling is enabled for a WhatsApp phone number. Creating this resource adopts the setting of an existing number; destroying it leaves the setting as it is.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Destroy leaves the setting as it is.
resource "telnyx_whatsapp_phone_number_calling_settings" "support" {
  phone_number = telnyx_whatsapp_phone_number.support.phone_number
  enabled      = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether WhatsApp calling is enabled for the phone number.
- `phone_number` (String) The WhatsApp phone number in E.164 format.

### Read-Only

- `record_type` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_whatsapp_phone_number_calling_settings.support <phone_number>
```
